properties.entry: SELECT CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN, ID_TAREA HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_EMPLEADO_ESTRUCTURA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_PRESENCIA_SECCION WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_VENTA_SECCION WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea

SELECT * FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea AND ((ID_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL IS NULL OR ID_EMPLEADO_LOCAL = '') OR (CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN IS NULL OR CCL_ID_COD_ORIGEN = '') OR (STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT IS NULL OR STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT = '') OR (FECHA_FIN IS NULL ) OR (FECHA_INICIO IS NULL ) OR (OR_EMPLEADO IS NULL OR OR_EMPLEADO = '') OR (ID_TAREA IS NULL ))

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT ID_LOCALIZACION AS LOCALIZACION, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_AMBITO_LOCALIZACION WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY ID_LOCALIZACION UNION ALL SELECT STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT AS LOCALIZACION, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_WORK_LOCAT) SELECT LOCALIZACION, ROW_COUNT FROM TABLAS GROUP BY LOCALIZACION, ROW_COUNT HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT ID_PERSONA AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_AMBITO_PERSONA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY ID_PERSONA UNION ALL SELECT ID_EMPLEADO AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_PERSONA_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY ID_EMPLEADO) SELECT NAME, ROW_COUNT FROM TABLAS GROUP BY NAME, ROW_COUNT HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2

WITH TABLAS AS (SELECT STD_ID_LEG_ENT AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA_LOCALIZACION_HISTORICO WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY STD_ID_LEG_ENT UNION ALL SELECT ID_EMPRESA AS NAME, COUNT(*) AS ROW_COUNT FROM TAREA WHERE ID_TAREA = :idTarea GROUP BY ID_EMPRESA) SELECT NAME FROM TABLAS GROUP BY NAME HAVING COUNT(*) <> 2
